Method of Attack: Privilege escalation and remote code execution via removal of authentication header
Dropping botnet malware (Mirai) and cryptomining payloads
Closing exploited ports to prevent other botnets
Discoverer: Wiz researchers Nir Ohfeld and Shir Tamari
Attack Vector: Exploitation of OMI software agent vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-38647)
Scanning Internet for exposed Azure Linux VMs vulnerable to CVE-2021-38647
Removal of authentication header in OMI agent communication
Indicators of Compromise: Mirai botnet activity targeting Azure Linux OMI endpoints
Ports TCP 5985, 5986, and 1207 exposed and exploited
